$comment: From the take, three stretches picked in scripts/chop.mjs, joined so the song runs on without going back: each join on a bar line measured from the playhead (bar 3 sits at x 133 of the roll crop, 70 px a bar, ~1.576 s a bar). 1: the first play, bars 3 and 4 (kept short: no bass yet). 2: bars 5 to 10 of a later pass, the bass in throughout, strummed coming in. 3: bars 11 to 18, the bass and feel changes.
